Ative Controles manuais na TopBar. O pai: Enable Manual controls in the TopBar. The lower panel replaces the exposure scale in the same space and offers EV, ISO, SS (shutter speed), WB (white balance) and AF (focus). Select a setting on the left and drag the scale on the right to change its value.
AUTO indica que aquele controle está aut: AUTO indicates that a control is automatic. A brief tap on the scale returns ISO, SS, WB or AF to automatic; for EV, tapping returns to 0.0 EV. Leaving manual mode restores automatic settings; reopening the panel starts at EV.
Painel inferior com ISO, SS e WB; SS sel: Lower panel with ISO, SS and WB; SS selected, scale marked AUTO and lens 4 active.
No painel manual, SS seleciona a velocid: In the manual panel, SS selects shutter speed; AUTO indicates automatic adjustment.
ISO amplifica o sinal: valores maiores a: ISO amplifies the signal: higher values help in low light but may increase noise. A slower shutter gathers light for longer and increases the risk of camera shake and motion blur. A fast shutter helps freeze the subject, requiring more light or higher ISO.
A compensação EV orienta a exposição aut: EV compensation guides automatic exposure. It is not the same as changing the lens's physical aperture. When ISO and time are fixed, check the actual effect in the preview and file.
Comece no automático e altere uma variáv: Start in automatic mode and change one variable at a time.
Para assuntos em movimento, priorize vel: For moving subjects, prioritize shutter speed; for a still scene with support, try a longer exposure.
Se altas luzes importantes estourarem, r: If important highlights clip, reduce exposure; recovering detail later is not guaranteed.
Toque no assunto para definir o ponto de: Tap the subject to set the focus point when supported. Manual focus controls lens position; its value is not a distance in meters.
O balanço de branco modifica a aparência: White balance changes the appearance of temperature and tint. Keeping it stable helps compare photos of the same scene. Availability and limits come from the active camera.
O histograma mostra a distribuição de lu: The histogram shows luminance distribution; concentrations at the extremes call for attention to shadows and highlights. Zebra marks extreme regions in the preview. These aids are not recorded in the image.
Preview, efeitos e processamento do sist: Preview, effects and system processing may cause differences in the saved result. Check the final image, especially in RAW/HEIF+.

JPEG: opção para aplicativos e serviços: JPEG: an option for apps and services that need wider compatibility.

RAW + foto processada: salva um único it: RAW + processed photo: saves one library item with two original resources, DNG and HEIC/JPEG.
ProRAW and Bayer RAW are separate options. The app checks support on the active rear camera and shows each available mode, even if there is only one. Choosing Bayer does not silently substitute ProRAW.
RAW Bayer exige uma lente física com zoo: Bayer RAW requires a physical lens at native sensor zoom, without cropping or digital zoom. Selector numbers are relative to the lens system: 0.5×, 1× or 4× may correspond to physical lenses without digital zoom; stops such as 2× or 8× may be crops. Availability depends on the device, not just the displayed number.
Ao usar zoom digital, uma câmera virtual: Using digital zoom, a virtual camera or an unsupported lens turns Bayer off and re-enables processed output. ProRAW remains conditional on lens capabilities and may allow zoom. To return to Bayer, switch to a compatible physical lens without cropping and select Bayer RAW again.
Os dois modos permitem DNG sozinho, par: Both modes allow DNG alone, a HEIF/JPEG pair or HEIF+ development, depending on selected outputs. Photographic Styles affect only the HEIF companion or derivative; the DNG receives no styles.
No par HEIF+, a foto processada vem da r: In an HEIF+ pair, the processed photo comes from custom development and includes your effects. In an HEIF/JPEG pair, processing uses the companion image returned by native capture.
No iOS 27, o app solicita o DNG como ori: On iOS 27, the app requests the DNG as the pair's original. On earlier versions, Photos controls that choice. A badge or display order in another app does not prove which resources were imported.
O DNG preserva a área do sensor; a image: The DNG preserves the sensor area; the processed image follows the chosen aspect ratio.
O tamanho varia com a cena, lente e tipo: Size varies with the scene, lens and RAW type; there is no fixed size in MB.
O seletor bloqueia desligar a última saí: The selector blocks turning off the last output. When changing lenses, it keeps the chosen RAW mode and processed photo selection while the new session reports its capabilities. Confirming that the mode is unsupported, switching to the front camera or using digital zoom in Bayer turns RAW off and enables the processed photo.
Live Photo e Retrato exigem RAW desligad: Live Photo and Portrait require RAW to be off. Image Stacking suspends RAW and restores the selection when you leave. HEIF+ pauses during Live Photo, Portrait, stacking or use of a camera without RAW.
As exportações HEIC/JPEG do iOS usam per: iOS HEIC/JPEG exports use a Display P3 ICC profile. Conversion respects the input profile; sensor data in the DNG remains intact. LUTs applied in the WebView work in sRGB, and later conversion to P3 does not recover colors already limited there.
10-bit descreve precisão de cor; não gar: 10-bit describes color precision; it does not guarantee an HDR image. When sharing a pair, confirm which resources the destination app exports and check GPS, authorship and tags.
iOS com RAW/ProRAW disponível na lente a: iOS with RAW/ProRAW available on the active lens
Live Photo, Retrato e Image Stacking des: Live Photo, Portrait and Image Stacking turned off
Espaço para DNG temporário, revelação e: Space for temporary DNG, development and saving
HEIF+ captura um DNG e o revela com CIRA: HEIF+ captures a DNG and develops it with CIRAWFilter. The camera's processed companion image is not the source for this pipeline. The app crops, applies LUT, halation and grain, and exports HEIF.
Escolha HEIF+ em Foto processada no cont: Choose HEIF+ in Processed photo in the TopBar File format control. Adjust development in Settings → Capture and files → HEIF+ Development. If Bayer RAW or ProRAW is also selected, that DNG accompanies the HEIC in the same library item. With RAW set to None, the app uses ProRAW when available, or Bayer as a fallback, only as a temporary development source.
Nitidez, redução de ruído, clareza, equi: Sharpness, noise reduction, clarity, light balance, EV exposure, global curve, shadows, temperature and tint act during file development. They differ from controls that determine sensor exposure before shooting.
Automático da Apple preserva a calibraçã: Apple Automatic preserves per-image calibration. The initial profile uses gentle values for sharpness, noise, clarity and light balance. There is no live RAW preview: compare saved files when evaluating a setting.
Recuperação de altas luzes requer iOS 26: Highlight recovery requires iOS 26 and file support; the module checks each DNG.
RAW 9 é solicitado apenas quando disponí: RAW 9 is requested only when available on iOS 27. If its capabilities are not ready, the pipeline tries an earlier supported decoder.
Ruído cromático, detalhe e moiré não ofe: Chroma noise, detail and moiré do not offer effective adjustments in RAW 9. Displayed support corresponds to the last inspected capture.
O pipeline tenta HEIF de 10-bit em Displ: The pipeline attempts 10-bit HEIF in Display P3 with compression quality 0.8. If the encoder fails, it may try 8-bit, except for file or storage errors. The recipe records effective bit depth. Output is SDR.
A cópia sem efeitos mantém a mesma revel: The copy without effects keeps the same RAW development, without LUT, halation or grain. It is not the DNG or a version without all processing. Grain and detail affect file size.
Até três trabalhos ficam em Application: Up to three jobs are kept in Application Support, excluded from backup. Each stores capture settings, project, location, effects, authorship and date. Development and saving run serially.
O app usa o tempo de background concedid: The app uses background time granted by iOS. When it expires, the job is kept for resumption; completion with the app closed is not guaranteed. On failure, it offers Retry, Later or Discard. Settings also shows pending jobs.
Depois mantém o trabalho para uma tentat: Later keeps the job for a future attempt.
Tentar novamente retoma a operação; chec: Retry resumes the operation; checkpoints reuse already confirmed assets.
Descartar remove o trabalho pendente e s: Discard removes the pending job and its temporary source; choose this only if you do not want to recover it.
Testes nativos com imagens sintéticas ve: Native tests with synthetic images verify export, effects, metadata and recovery. Real Bayer RAW and ProRAW quality, control differences, timing, memory and interruptions still need checking on a physical iPhone. The implementation alone does not prove quality on every lens.
iOS e módulo nativo atualizado: iOS and an updated native module
Apoio ou tripé para sequências longas: Support or tripod for long sequences
O resultado depende da duração, estabili: The result depends on duration, stability and scene. The preview is a reference; check the exported composition.
Faça a primeira foto, reenquadre usando: Take the first photo, reframe using its overlay in the preview and shoot again. The mode explicitly waits for the second exposure. The two frames are not aligned: element placement is part of the composition.
As imagens são somadas como luz em espaç: Images are added as light in linear space and receive a curve for SDR output. Default internal compensation of −1.5 EV leaves headroom for highlights. Interface EV affects camera exposure before each shot and is independent of this compensation.
Durante a sequência, orientação, lente e: During the sequence, orientation, lens and other controls are locked; shutter, Cancel and EV remain available.
A composição pode receber LUT, grão, hal: The composition can receive LUT, grain, halation, cropping and project organization. The result is exported as HEIF or JPEG.
Salvar original sem efeitos preserva a c: Save original without effects preserves the composition before effects, not the frames used to build it. RAW, Live Photo, Portrait, flash and general manual controls follow mode restrictions. Intermediate files are removed on completion, failure or cancellation.
O alinhamento tenta registrar o moviment: Alignment attempts to register global camera movement; it does not correct all local scene movement. Check for artifacts in water, people and moving objects. Perspective changes and low texture may prevent registration.
Qualidade, cancelamento, pressão de memó: Quality, cancellation, memory pressure, low storage and camera resumption need validation on a physical device.
iOS, Metal e lente física com foco manua: iOS, Metal and a physical lens with manual focus and exposure/white balance locking
Cena parada e aparelho apoiado ou em tri: Static scene and a supported device or tripod

Arraste os dois seletores da régua Perto: Drag both handles on the Near → Far scale and check each focus in the preview.
Toque nos dois seletores para confirmar: Tap both handles to confirm the limits on the camera. The orange segment indicates the range.
Escolha de 3 a 20 fotos no dial; o padrã: Choose 3 to 20 photos on the dial; the default is 10.
Dispare e mantenha câmera e assunto para: Shoot and keep the camera and subject still throughout the sequence.
A régua é uma posição normalizada da len: The scale is a normalized lens position. It does not measure distance in meters or f/ aperture. Choose limits based on observed sharpness in the nearest and farthest subject planes.
Trocar câmera, lente ou zoom invalida os: Changing camera, lens or zoom invalidates the limits and requires reconfirming them. The chosen count remains for the session. More photos increase work; they do not guarantee better results if there is movement.
A câmera estabiliza e trava exposição e: The camera stabilizes and locks exposure and white balance. The sequence includes both limits and evenly distributes intermediate positions. Each photo waits for focus confirmation; orientation is frozen.
A foto central é a referência. O engine: The center photo is the reference. The engine registers the others, calculates sharper regions and blends them using masks and a five-level Laplacian pyramid in linear space. Cropping uses the valid intersection and may reduce the framing.
Qualquer foto ausente ou sem registro vá: Any missing photo or invalid registration causes the entire sequence to fail; this mode does not deliver a degraded result. The crop must preserve at least 65% of the reference width and height.
A espera pelo foco tem limite de quatro: Focus wait is limited to four seconds; capture to twenty seconds. Cancellation is also checked during these waits. There is no 3D reconstruction or local motion compensation. People, leaves in the wind and unsupported macro photography may cause problems.
Somente a composição vai à fila de efeit: Only the composition goes to the effects and saving queue. The copy without effects is also the composition, without LUT, grain or halation; temporary sources are deleted. Metadata records limits, count and confirmed focus positions.
Ao concluir ou cancelar, o foco volta à: On completion or cancellation, focus returns to the panel position. Turning the mode off returns controls to automatic. Check the next capture and source cleanup when testing interruptions.
iOS 27 e build com SDK compatível para s: iOS 27 and a build with a compatible SDK to sync ratings with the Photos catalog
Em Configurações → Captura e arquivos →: In Settings → Capture and files → Authorship, enter author and copyright. Values stay on the device and apply to future captures; empty fields add no authorship. Changing these options does not change existing photos.
No iOS 27 com SDK compatível, a transaçã: On iOS 27 with a compatible SDK, the transaction updates the Photos catalog and image XMP. Catalog reading, including zero, respects changes made in Photos. On other platforms, the thumbnail uses the rating read from the image.
Zero significa sem classificação e não e: Zero means unrated and displays no indicator on the thumbnail.
Na grade, toque em Selecionar ou mantenh: In the grid, tap Select or press and hold a thumbnail to apply the same rating to multiple photos. Canceling keeps completed writes; failures and pending items remain selected.
Notas antigas apenas no XMP precisam ser: Old ratings stored only in XMP need to be selected again to enter the catalog; reading does not automatically migrate them.
No iOS, a edição preserva o original. Pa: On iOS, editing preserves the original. For RAW, the rating is stored in the rendered representation and the original DNG is kept.
EXIF registra informações fotográficas,: EXIF records photographic information such as ISO, exposure, lens and GPS. IPTC/XMP records authorship and keywords; xmp:Rating receives a score from 0 to 5. The Komorebi recipe records effects and capture mode information.
JPEG usa segmentos APP13 para IPTC e APP: JPEG uses APP13 segments for IPTC and APP1 for XMP. TIFF/DNG uses IFD0 fields without moving RAW data. HEIF uses ImageIO serialization. Destination apps may read only some fields or remove them on export.
A opção de localização afeta novas captu: The location option affects new captures and requires permission; turning it off does not remove coordinates from older photos. The map uses external OpenStreetMap tiles centered on the photo's location. EXIF Frame opens an external service in a WebView.
Antes de compartilhar, confira o arquivo: Before sharing, check the actual exported file, including location, author, rights and keywords. A name or tag may also reveal scene context.

Em Configurações → Barra de controles, e: In Settings → Control bar, choose which controls appear and reorder them. The TopBar accepts up to eight controls, including Settings, which cannot be removed.
Toque em um ponto do preview para defini: Tap a point in the preview to set focus on compatible cameras.
O DNG preserva a área do sensor; a foto: The DNG preserves the sensor area; the processed photo in a pair follows the selected aspect ratio. In Megapixels, choose a preferred RAW resolution of 12, 24 or 48 MP; the lens and mode may deliver fewer pixels.
A preferência também é aplicada a Live P: The preference also applies to Live Photos, portraits and copies without effects when the capture flow allows it.

Em Configurações → Captura e arquivos →: In Settings → Capture and files → Megapixels, choose 12, 24 or 48 MP separately for RAW and HEIF/JPEG. Defaults are 48 MP for RAW and 24 MP for HEIF/JPEG. Bayer may be limited to around 12 MP; ProRAW depends on the lens. Smaller photos are never upscaled.
Motion Blur faz uma média temporal com a: Motion Blur uses a temporal average with global alignment to simulate a long exposure. Moving elements can blur while stable areas remain more defined.
Abra Image Stacking na TopBar. O seletor: Open Image Stacking in the TopBar. The selector offers Light Trails, Motion Blur, Double Exposure and Focus Bracketing according to lens support.

Grave autoria, classifique fotos e enten: Record authorship, rate photos and understand GPS, EXIF, IPTC and XMP.
Abra uma foto e toque em Informações par: Open a photo and tap Information to view EXIF and location, organize projects, rate and share. Under Create and edit, expand Blur or Photographic Styles to see its options; only one of these features expands at a time.
Abra uma foto, toque em Informações e ex: Open a photo, tap Information and expand Blur under Create and edit. Depth generation uses a model included in the app and runs locally, without a first-use download or sending the photo to a server. Android does not offer this action.
Abra a foto e toque em Informações. Esco: Open the photo and tap Information. Choose a rating; the crossed-out star explicitly writes zero. The interface confirms only after saving and reports permission or storage failures.
Mudanças de modo, efeito e lente ficam b: Mode, effect and lens changes are blocked during capture, processing and countdown. Finishing Light Trails or Motion Blur remains immediate.

O Komorebi requer iOS 18 ou Android 8. C: Komorebi requires iOS 18 or Android 8. Full manual controls, RAW/ProRAW, Live Photo, portrait, Camera Control, widgets and shortcuts depend on iOS and device support. HEIF+, Image Stacking, Photographic Styles and gallery depth generation also require iOS; quality and performance vary by lens and need physical-device validation.
Faça um tour pela câmera: Take a tour of the camera
Na última etapa do onboarding, Quer faze: On the last onboarding step, Would you like a tour of the app? is enabled. After you finish, the tour introduces available shortcuts and the main camera controls. Turn it off if you prefer to explore on your own. To revisit onboarding, use Settings → About and support → Review introduction.
Em Configurações → Idioma, escolha portu: In Settings → Language, choose Portuguese, English, Japanese, German, Spanish or French. Automatic follows the device’s primary language; unsupported languages use English. Your manual choice is saved on the device. Project names, LUT names and authorship are preserved.
No iOS, abra Configurações → Widgets e A: On iOS, open Settings → Widgets and Shortcuts and create presets with a name, icon and color. Set a filter, format, aspect ratio, camera, flash, timer, grain and halation or keep the current settings. You can also choose a background image from your library.
Um painel reúne até oito presets. O widg: A panel holds up to eight presets. The medium widget shows the first four; the large widget shows up to eight. In the iOS widget gallery, find Komorebi, add Camera preset or Camera panel, then edit the widget to choose a saved item.
O controle Preset Komorebi abre a câmera: The Preset Komorebi control opens the full camera after unlocking your iPhone. It can be used on the Lock Screen, in Control Center and with a compatible Action Button.
No app Atalhos, Abrir preset e Abrir câm: In the Shortcuts app, Open preset and Open configured camera only open and configure the camera; you decide when to take a photo. Options incompatible with the lens are skipped with a notice.
Os ajustes de um preset duram na sessão,: Preset settings last for the session, including navigation and returning from the background. Closing the app restores saved preferences. Presets and background images stay local, without iCloud sync.
Em Configurações → Captura e arquivos →: In Settings → Capture and files → Megapixels, choose 12, 24 or 48 MP separately for RAW and HEIF/JPEG. Defaults are 48 MP for RAW and 24 MP for HEIF/JPEG. The lens and mode may deliver a lower resolution; smaller photos are never upscaled.
No par RAW + foto processada, as duas pr: In a RAW + processed photo pair, both preferences are respected. Live Photo and Portrait follow native limits; Image Stacking keeps the strategy’s resolution. Aspect-ratio cropping may reduce the final pixel count.
Selecione Image Stacking → Rastros de lu: Select Image Stacking → Light Trails. Mount your iPhone on a tripod and frame headlights, moving lights or light painting. Adjust exposure before starting. One tap on the shutter starts capture; another ends it immediately. Cancel discards the capture; the automatic limit is five minutes.
O modo conserva os rastros mais claros c: The mode preserves brighter trails as lights move. Enable the stacking preview to follow the accumulated result. Keep the camera still: this mode does not align frames. Noise and intersecting colors can affect the result.
O resultado exige pelo menos um segundo: The result requires at least one second and five valid frames. Resolution comes from the video stream, limited to 4096 pixels on the longest side. Leaving the camera or sending the app to the background cancels the sequence.
No iOS, abra uma foto, toque em Informaç: On iOS, open a photo, tap Information and expand Photographic Styles under Create and edit. When the image is eligible, Create copy with Styles saves a HEIF copy of the current version and keeps the original. Open the copy in Apple Photos to edit styles. The Photographic Styles 3 option adds texture and grain on compatible devices and iOS versions.
No iOS, ative Configurações → Câmera → F: On iOS, enable Settings → Camera → Focus peaking to highlight high-contrast edges and help adjust focus. The highlight follows the preview and is not saved in the photo. Check the saved result: contrast and lighting can affect the indication.
Rastros de luz, Motion Blur e Dupla expo: Light Trails, Motion Blur and Double Exposure on iOS.
LUTs personalizados e a geração experime: Custom LUTs and experimental depth generation are local. The depth model is included in the app, including for eligible Live Photos.
Projetos, volume, GPS, clima e EXIF Fram: Projects, volume buttons, GPS, weather and EXIF Frame also depend on the conditions described in the documentation.
O compartilhamento de uso e diagnósticos: Usage and diagnostics sharing starts enabled and can be disabled during beta onboarding or in Settings → About and support → Share usage and diagnostics. The preference stays on the device and controls PostHog and Sentry. Turning it off blocks new transmissions and discards pending usage events; the services do not start on subsequent launches. Requests already in progress may finish and previously sent data is not deleted.
Esses provedores têm políticas próprias,: These providers have their own policies, including for technical network data. Data sent to Sentry and PostHog is retained according to each service’s policies.
O Komorebi não exibe anúncios, não integ: Komorebi does not display ads, integrate advertising networks or sell data. With sharing enabled, PostHog receives usage, onboarding, permission and capture outcome events, plus a random identifier, app version and technical device information. The app does not send photos, RAW, EXIF, GPS, file or album names, or custom LUT contents to PostHog. It does not use personal profiles, session replay or automatic tap capture; IP geolocation is disabled in the integration.
Os dados locais ficam sujeitos às proteç: Local data is subject to device protections. You control retention by deleting photos, removing LUTs, revoking permissions or uninstalling the app. Uninstalling removes private depth backups and does not necessarily remove saved photos. Reverting compatible edits requires available backups; transmitted usage and diagnostics data follows PostHog and Sentry retention policies.
Desativar o compartilhamento de uso e di: Disable usage and diagnostics sharing; questions or requests about previously sent data can be submitted through the contact channels.
Preferências incluem grade, som, formato: Preferences include grid, sound, image format, megapixels, language, original copy and TopBar settings. Widget presets and background images stay on the device; reduced copies of backgrounds, without the original photo’s metadata, are shared with the iOS extension, without iCloud sync.
Em Sobre e suporte → Compartilhar uso e: In About and support → Share usage and diagnostics, control usage sharing with PostHog and error reporting with Sentry. The option starts enabled. Turning it off blocks new transmissions and discards pending usage events; the services do not start on the next launch. Requests already in progress may finish and previously sent data is not deleted. These integrations do not send photos or location.
Sim. Fotos, preferências, LUTs personali: Yes. Photos, preferences, custom LUTs and depth generation stay on the device. Weather, maps and EXIF Frame use external services. Usage sharing with PostHog and diagnostics sharing with Sentry starts enabled and can be disabled during beta onboarding or in Settings → About and support. These integrations do not send photos or location; recording GPS in photos is optional.
Na mesma tela, Estilos Fotográficos 3 ac: On the same screen, Photographic Styles 3 adds texture and grain to editable styles on compatible iPhones and iOS versions. Check the available options when opening the photo in Apple Photos.
O formato é escolhido no atalho Formato: Choose the format from the File format shortcut in the TopBar. Capture and files includes Megapixels, copies without effects, authorship, location, Photographic Styles and HEIF+ development settings on iOS.
Indicador de altas luzes e Indicador de: Highlight indicator and Shadow indicator mark exposure extremes in the iOS preview. Focus peaking highlights edges to help with focus. These indicators do not appear in the saved photo.
Megapixels: escolha 12, 24 ou 48 MP sepa: Megapixels: choose 12, 24 or 48 MP separately for RAW and HEIF/JPEG, within lens and mode limits. Custom LUTs lets you import and remove local .cube files.
Preferências de 12, 24 ou 48 MP; padrões: Preferences of 12, 24 or 48 MP; defaults of 48 MP for RAW and 24 MP for HEIF/JPEG. The lens, mode and crop may reduce final resolution; smaller photos are never upscaled.
Ativado em Configurações → Câmera no iOS: Enabled in Settings → Camera on iOS. Highlights edges in the preview to help with focus; does not change the saved photo.
Requer iOS e integração nativa disponíve: Requires iOS and an available native integration. Presets open and configure the camera without taking a photo; settings last for the session and respect lens capabilities.
Open-Meteo, BigDataCloud, Leaflet, OpenS: Open-Meteo, BigDataCloud, Leaflet, OpenStreetMap, unpkg, the EXIF Frame generator, Notion, Sentry, PostHog and external links have their own terms and policies. The Komorebi team does not control their availability or practices.
O site oferece os mesmos seis idiomas. U: The website supports the same six languages. Use the language selector in the header to switch without leaving the current page.
